name: ANSEL DUVARRE
bio: Loom's second seam-walker after Cato Wren, and the only one who preferred the Understitch to any strand. In 2019 he moved every known crossing to doors that opened only for the Unspooled. A map is a list of doors you were allowed.
catchphrase: A map is only a list of the doors you were allowed to use.

theme.tagline: Every door answers to him now.
